title: Wives and Husbands, Suffering for Righteousness' Sake

questions.question: Likewise, wives, be ____ to your own husbands, so that even if some do not obey the word, they may be won without a word by the conduct of their wives,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:1 (ESV): "Likewise, wives, be subject to your own husbands, so that even if some do not obey the word, they may be won without a word by the conduct of their wives,"

questions.question: when they see your ____ and pure conduct.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:2 (ESV): "when they see your respectful and pure conduct."

questions.question: Do not let your adorning be external—the braiding of hair and the putting on of gold jewelry, or the clothing you wear—but let your adorning be the hidden person of the ____
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:3-4 (ESV): "Do not let your adorning be external—the braiding of hair and the putting on of gold jewelry, or the clothing you wear— but let your adorning be the hidden person of the heart with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which in God's sight is very precious."

questions.question: with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet ____, which in God's sight is very precious.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:4 (ESV): "...with the imperishable beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit, which in God's sight is very precious."

questions.question: For this is how the holy women who hoped in God used to adorn themselves, by submitting to their own husbands, as ____ obeyed Abraham, calling him lord.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:5-6 (ESV): "For this is how the holy women who hoped in God used to adorn themselves, by submitting to their own husbands, as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord. And you are her children, if you do good and do not fear anything that is frightening."

questions.question: Likewise, husbands, live with your wives in an understanding way, showing honor to the woman as the ____ vessel,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:7 (ESV): "Likewise, husbands, live with your wives in an understanding way, showing honor to the woman as the weaker vessel, since they are heirs with you of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be hindered."

questions.question: since they are heirs with you of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be ____.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:7 (ESV): "...since they are heirs with you of the grace of life, so that your prayers may not be hindered."

questions.question: Finally, all of you, have unity of mind, sympathy, ____ love, a tender heart, and a humble mind.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:8 (ESV): "Finally, all of you, have unity of mind, sympathy, brotherly love, a tender heart, and a humble mind."

questions.question: Do not repay evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary, ____, for to this you were called, that you may obtain a blessing.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:9 (ESV): "Do not repay evil for evil or reviling for reviling, but on the contrary, bless, for to this you were called, that you may obtain a blessing."

questions.question: For "Whoever desires to love life and see good days, let him keep his ____ from evil and his lips from speaking deceit;"
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:10 (ESV): "For 'Whoever desires to love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit;'"

questions.question: let him turn away from evil and do good; let him seek ____ and pursue it.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:11 (ESV): "let him turn away from evil and do good; let him seek peace and pursue it."

questions.question: but in your hearts honor Christ the Lord as holy, always being prepared to make a ____ to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you;
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:15 (ESV): "but in your hearts honor Christ the Lord as holy, always being prepared to make a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you; yet do it with gentleness and respect,"

questions.question: yet do it with ____ and ____, having a good conscience...
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:15-16 (ESV): "...yet do it with gentleness and respect, having a good conscience..."

questions.question: For it is better to suffer for doing ____, if that should be God's will, than for doing evil.
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:17 (ESV): "For it is better to suffer for doing good, if that should be God's will, than for doing evil."

questions.question: For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh but made alive in the ____,
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 3:18 (ESV): "For Christ also suffered once for sins, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring us to God, being put to death in the flesh but made alive in the spirit,"

key_verse_text: but in your hearts honor Christ the Lord as holy, always being prepared to make a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you; yet do it with gentleness and respect,
